name: Radicale
description: Calendar (CalDAV) and contacts (CardDAV) server for phones, Thunderbird and Outlook.
notes: Create users by adding them to ./config/users in the app's folder (docker/app-radicale); see the Radicale docs.
compose:
services:
  radicale:
    image: tomsquest/docker-radicale:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "5232:5232"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data
